findings.title: Off-by-one error in totalPages and pagination offset when user_count is a multiple of limit
findings.body: `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`, which is 1 too high whenever `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50 users with a limit of 50 yields 2 pages instead of 1; use `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` or `Math.floor((user_count - 1) / limit) + 1`). Consequently, clicking `next` on the last actual page is not blocked by `showingLast` and sets `offset` to `user_count` (line 33), loading an empty extra page (`2/2` with 0 members).

findings.title: alias_level is ignored when creating a new group
findings.body: `Admin::GroupsController#create` sets `name` and `visible` on the new `Group` record, but ignores `params[:alias_level]` even though the group creation form (`admin/templates/group.hbs`) displays the alias level selector and `Discourse.Group#asJSON` sends `alias_level` in the POST payload. Any alias level chosen by the admin when creating a group is silently discarded.

findings.title: Adding an already-present member to a group raises ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
findings.body: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, `group.add(user)` (`group.users.push(user)`) is called without checking whether the user is already a member of the group (`group.users.include?(user)` or `GroupUser.exists?(group_id: group.id, user_id: user.id)`). Because `group_users` has a unique index on `(group_id, user_id)`, adding an existing member raises `ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique` and returns a 500 error instead of succeeding or returning a validation error.

findings.title: Unbounded and unvalidated limit/offset parameters in GroupsController#members
findings.body: `GroupsController#members` accepts user-supplied `params[:limit]` and `params[:offset]` directly (`limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`, `offset = params[:offset].to_i`) without clamping them. A client can pass a negative `limit`/`offset` (causing a Postgres `PG::Error: LIMIT/OFFSET must not be negative` 500 error) or a huge `limit` to serialize all users in a large group in a single request.
